~~~js
/**
 * ShareholderCharts Module (issue5)
 * 股东分析 Tab 的图表与列表渲染：股东户数走势、机构持仓变化、十大股东、基金持股。
 * 使用已注册的 softDark 主题；任一数据缺失时优雅降级为"暂无数据"提示。
 */
const ShareholderCharts = {
  instances: {},

  disposeAll() {
    Object.values(this.instances).forEach(c => { try { c.dispose(); } catch {} });
    this.instances = {};
  },

  _init(id) {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!el) return null;
    if (this.instances[id]) { try { this.instances[id].dispose(); } catch {} }
    let chart = echarts.init(el, 'softDark', { renderer: 'canvas' });
    if (window.SA_CHART) chart = SA_CHART.attach(chart); // setOption 自动过视觉修补
    this.instances[id] = chart;
    return chart;
  },

  // 主渲染入口：data 来自 /api/shareholders/:symbol
  renderAll(container, data) {
    this.disposeAll();
    if (!container) return;
    const d = data || {};

    const summary = this._buildSummary(d);
    const holderCard = d.holderCountTrendAvailable
      ? `<div class="chart-card large"><h3>👥 股东户数走势${d.priceTrendAvailable ? '<label class="sh-toggle"><input type="checkbox" id="shHolderPriceToggle" checked> 叠加股价走势</label>' : ''}</h3><div id="shHolderTrend" class="chart"></div></div>`
      : `<div class="chart-card large"><h3>👥 股东户数走势</h3><div class="sh-empty">暂无股东户数数据（F10 未披露或接口暂不可用）</div></div>`;

    const instHoldCard = d.institutionHoldingsAvailable
      ? `<div class="chart-card large"><h3>🏦 机构持仓变化<span class="sh-sub">（按报告期：机构家数 / 占流通股比）</span></h3><div id="shInstHoldTrend" class="chart"></div><div id="shInstHoldNote"></div></div>`
      : `<div class="chart-card large"><h3>🏦 机构持仓变化</h3><div class="sh-empty">暂无机构持仓数据（F10 未披露或接口暂不可用）</div></div>`;

    const fundCard = d.fundHoldingsAvailable
      ? `<div class="chart-card large"><h3>📊 基金持股<span class="sh-sub">（最新报告期前 10 大持仓基金）</span></h3><div id="shFundHold" class="sh-holders"></div></div>`
      : `<div class="chart-card large"><h3>📊 基金持股</h3><div class="sh-empty">暂无基金持股数据（F10 未披露或接口暂不可用）</div></div>`;

    const topShareholdersRatioCard = d.topShareholdersAvailable
      ? `<div class="chart-card large"><h3>📊 前十大股东持股比例<span class="sh-sub">（最新报告期：${d.topShareholders[0]?.endDate || '—'}）</span></h3><div id="shTopHoldersPie" class="chart"></div><div id="shTopHoldersPieNote"></div></div>`
      : `<div class="chart-card large"><h3>📊 前十大股东持股比例</h3><div class="sh-empty">暂无十大股东数据（F10 未披露或接口暂不可用）</div></div>`;

    const holdersCard = d.topShareholdersAvailable
      ? `<div class="chart-card large"><h3>📋 十大股东明细<span class="sh-sub">（最新报告期：${d.topShareholders[0]?.endDate || '—'}）</span></h3><div id="shTopHolders" class="sh-holders"></div></div>`
      : `<div class="chart-card large"><h3>📋 十大股东明细</h3><div class="sh-empty">暂无十大股东数据（F10 未披露或接口暂不可用）</div></div>`;

    container.innerHTML = `
      ${summary}
      ${topShareholdersRatioCard}
      ${holderCard}
      ${instHoldCard}
      ${holdersCard}
      ${fundCard}
    `;

    if (d.topShareholdersAvailable && d.topShareholders?.length) {
      this._renderTopHoldersPie(d.topShareholders);
    }

    if (d.holderCountTrendAvailable && d.holderCountTrend?.length) {
      this._renderHolderTrend(d.holderCountTrend, d.priceTrend);
    }
    if (d.institutionHoldingsAvailable && d.institutionHoldings?.length) {
      this._renderInstHoldTrend(d.institutionHoldings);
    }
    if (d.topShareholdersAvailable && d.topShareholders?.length) {
      this._renderTopHolders(d.topShareholders);
    }
    if (d.fundHoldingsAvailable && d.fundHoldings?.length) {
      this._renderFundHoldings(d.fundHoldings);
    }
  },

  _buildSummary(d) {
    const holderTrend = d.holderCountTrend || [];
    const latestHolders = holderTrend.length ? holderTrend[holderTrend.length - 1] : null;
    const latestTopDate = d.topShareholders?.length ? d.topShareholders[0]?.endDate : '';
    const ihArr = d.institutionHoldings || [];
    const latestIH = ihArr.length ? ihArr[ihArr.length - 1] : null;
    const sourceNote = `数据来源：东方财富 F10${latestHolders?.date ? ' · 股东户数 ' + latestHolders.date : ''}${latestTopDate ? ' · 十大股东 ' + latestTopDate : ''}${latestIH ? ' · 机构持仓 ' + latestIH.date : ''}${d.fundHoldings?.length ? ' · 基金持股 ' + (d.fundHoldings[0]?.date || '') : ''}`;

    const items = [];
    items.push(['第一大股东', d.controllingShareholder || '—']);
    if (latestHolders) {
      const changeTxt = latestHolders.changeRatio != null
        ? `${latestHolders.changeRatio >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${latestHolders.changeRatio.toFixed(2)}% 环比`
        : '—';
      items.push(['最新股东户数', `${latestHolders.holderNum.toLocaleString('zh-CN')} 户 (${changeTxt})`]);
      if (latestHolders.avgFreeShares) {
        items.push(['户均持股', `${latestHolders.avgFreeShares.toLocaleString('zh-CN')} 股`]);
      }
      if (latestHolders.focus) {
        items.push(['持股集中度', latestHolders.focus]);
      }
    }

    return `<div class="sh-summary">${items.map(([k, v]) => `
      <div class="sh-summary-item">
        <span class="sh-summary-label">${k}</span>
        <span class="sh-summary-value">${v}</span>
      </div>`).join('')}<div class="sh-summary-note">${sourceNote}</div></div>`;
  },

  // 默认视窗：报告期较多时只显示最近 12 期（与东财一致），完整历史仍可拖动下方滑块查看
  _zoomFor(n, win = 12) {
    if (!n || n <= win) return { start: 0, end: 100 };
    return { start: +(((n - win) / n) * 100).toFixed(2), end: 100 };
  },

  // 在图（或列表）元素之后插入/更新一行数据来源 + 报告期说明
  _setSource(afterElId, text) {
    const anchor = document.getElementById(afterElId);
    if (!anchor) return;
    const id = afterElId + 'Src';
    let el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!el) {
      el = document.createElement('div');
      el.id = id;
      el.className = 'sh-source';
      anchor.parentNode.insertBefore(el, anchor.nextSibling);
    }
    el.textContent = text;
  },

  _renderHolderTrend(trend, priceTrend) {
    const chart = this._init('shHolderTrend');
    if (!chart) return;
    this._holderChart = chart;
    // 20260929a：切换「叠加股价走势」后只重绘图表，不重建 DOM
    const hasPrice = Array.isArray(priceTrend) && priceTrend.some(p => p && p.close != null);
    this._holderState = { trend, priceTrend, hasPrice, showPrice: hasPrice };
    this._renderHolderChart();

    const toggleEl = document.getElementById('shHolderPriceToggle');
    if (toggleEl) {
      toggleEl.checked = this._holderState.showPrice;
      toggleEl.addEventListener('change', () => {
        this._holderState.showPrice = toggleEl.checked;
        this._renderHolderChart();
      });
    }

    const latest = trend[trend.length - 1];
    const priceNote = hasPrice ? ' · 股价取各报告期收盘价（与户数同坐标对比）' : '';
    this._setSource('shHolderTrend', `数据来源：东方财富 F10 · 股东户数（${latest.date}）· 共 ${trend.length} 个报告期${priceNote}`);
  },

  // 根据当前开关状态重绘（支持动态增减「股价」轴/系列）
  _renderHolderChart() {
    const chart = this._holderChart;
    const st = this._holderState;
    if (!chart || !st) return;
    const dates = st.trend.map(t => t.date);
    const nums = st.trend.map(t => t.holderNum);
    const ratios = st.trend.map(t => t.changeRatio);
    const priceCloses = st.priceTrend
      ? st.priceTrend.map(p => (p && p.close != null ? p.close : null))
      : [];
    const showPrice = st.showPrice && st.hasPrice;
    const z = this._zoomFor(st.trend.length);

    const yAxes = [
      { type: 'value', name: '户数', axisLabel: { formatter: v => (v / 1e4).toFixed(1) + '万' } },
      { type: 'value', name: '环比%', position: 'right' },
    ];
    if (showPrice) {
      yAxes.push({
        type: 'value', name: '股价', position: 'right', offset: 55,
        axisLabel: { formatter: v => v.toFixed(2) }, splitLine: { show: false },
      });
    }

    const series = [
      {
        name: '股东户数', type: 'bar', data: nums,
        itemStyle: { color: '#5470c6' }, barWidth: '50%',
      },
      {
        name: '环比变化%', type: 'line', yAxisIndex: 1, smooth: true, data: ratios,
        lineStyle: { width: 2, color: '#cdab74' }, itemStyle: { color: '#cdab74' },
      },
    ];
    const legendData = ['股东户数', '环比变化%'];
    if (showPrice) {
      series.push({
        name: '股价', type: 'line', yAxisIndex: 2, smooth: true, data: priceCloses,
        // [20261109b] 股价叠加线是「绝对价位序列」而非涨跌信号 → 中性蓝，不占用方向色
        lineStyle: { width: 2, color: '#7fa8c9', type: 'dashed' }, itemStyle: { color: '#7fa8c9' },
      });
      legendData.push('股价');
    }

    const zoom = [{ type: 'inside', start: z.start, end: z.end }, { type: 'slider', height: 18, bottom: 12, start: z.start, end: z.end }];
    let opt;
    if (window.SA3D && SA3D.bar25D) {
      const b = SA3D.bar25D({
        xData: dates,
        legend: { data: legendData, top: 0 },
        grid: { left: 60, right: showPrice ? 110 : 60, top: 40, bottom: 50 },
        xAxis: { type: 'category', data: dates, axisLabel: { rotate: 30 } },
        yAxis: yAxes,
        axisPointer: { type: 'line' },
        series: [
          { name: '股东户数', type: 'bar', data: nums.map(v => ({ value: v, color: '#5470c6' })) },
          {
            name: '环比变化%', type: 'line', yAxisIndex: 1, smooth: true, data: ratios,
            lineStyle: { width: 2, color: '#cdab74' }, itemStyle: { color: '#cdab74' },
          },
          ...(showPrice ? [{
            name: '股价', type: 'line', yAxisIndex: 2, smooth: true, data: priceCloses,
            // [20261109b] 股价叠加线是「绝对价位序列」而非涨跌信号 → 中性蓝，不占用方向色
        lineStyle: { width: 2, color: '#7fa8c9', type: 'dashed' }, itemStyle: { color: '#7fa8c9' },
          }] : []),
        ],
      });
      b.dataZoom = zoom;
      opt = b;
    } else {
      opt = {
        tooltip: { trigger: 'axis', axisPointer: { type: 'line' } },
        legend: { data: legendData, top: 0 },
        grid: { left: 60, right: showPrice ? 110 : 60, top: 40, bottom: 50 },
        xAxis: { type: 'category', data: dates, axisLabel: { rotate: 30 } },
        yAxis: yAxes,
        dataZoom: zoom,
        series,
      };
    }
    chart.setOption(opt, { replaceMerge: ['yAxis', 'series'] });
  },

  _renderTopHoldersPie(holders) {
    const chart = this._init('shTopHoldersPie');
    const el = document.getElementById('shTopHoldersPie');
    if (!chart || !el) return;
    if (!holders || holders.length === 0) {
      el.innerHTML = '<div class="sh-empty">⚠️ 暂未获取到前十大股东数据。</div>';
      return;
    }

    const top1 = holders[0];
    const donutOpt = (window.SA3D && SA3D.donut) ? {
      centerText: top1 && top1.holdRatio != null
        ? { title: (top1.holdRatio != null ? top1.holdRatio.toFixed(1) + '%' : ''), sub: (top1.name || '').slice(0, 10) }
        : undefined,
      data: holders.map(h => ({ name: h.name || '未知', value: h.holdRatio })),
      center: ['40%', '50%'],
      radius: ['26%', '56%'],
      tooltipFmt: (p) => (p.seriesName === 'base' ? '' : `${p.name}: ${(p.value != null ? p.value.toFixed(2) : '--')}% (${p.percent != null ? p.percent.toFixed(2) : '--'}%)`),
      legend: { type: 'scroll', orient: 'vertical', right: 0, top: 'middle', itemWidth: 12, itemHeight: 8, textStyle: { fontSize: 11 } },
    } : null;
    if (donutOpt) {
      chart.setOption(SA3D.donut(donutOpt));
    } else {
      chart.setOption({
        tooltip: { trigger: 'item', formatter: (p) => `${p.name}: ${(p.value != null ? p.value.toFixed(2) : '--')}% (${p.percent != null ? p.percent.toFixed(2) : '--'}%)` },
        legend: { type: 'scroll', orient: 'vertical', right: 0, top: 'middle' },
        series: [{
          type: 'pie',
          radius: ['30%', '65%'],
          center: ['40%', '50%'],
          data: holders.map(h => ({ name: h.name || '未知', value: h.holdRatio })),
          label: { formatter: '{b}\n{d}%' },
        }],
      });
    }

    const institutionCount = holders.filter(h => h.type === '机构').length;
    const institutionRatio = holders.reduce((s, h) => s + (h.type === '机构' ? (h.holdRatio || 0) : 0), 0);
    const endDate = holders[0]?.endDate || '—';
    const noteId = 'shTopHoldersPieNote';
    let noteEl = document.getElementById(noteId);
    if (!noteEl) {
      noteEl = document.createElement('div');
      noteEl.id = noteId;
      noteEl.className = 'sh-stats-note';
      el.parentNode.insertBefore(noteEl, el.nextSibling);
    }
    noteEl.innerHTML = `
      <div class="sh-stats-main">前十大股东中共有 <b>${institutionCount}</b> 家机构，合计占总股本 <b>${institutionRatio.toFixed(2)}%</b>（报告期：${endDate}）</div>
      <div class="sh-stats-sub">注：饼图展示前十大股东各自占总股本比例。</div>
      <div class="sh-stats-sub">数据来源：东方财富 F10 · 十大股东（${endDate}）</div>
    `;
  },

  _renderTopHolders(holders) {
    const el = document.getElementById('shTopHolders');
    if (!el) return;
    const maxRatio = Math.max(...holders.map(h => h.holdRatio || 0), 1);

    const changeLabel = (c) => {
      if (c == null) return '<span class="sh-change neutral">—</span>';
      const num = Number(c);
      if (!isNaN(num) && String(c).trim() !== '') {
        if (num > 0) return `<span class="sh-change up">▲ 增持 ${num.toLocaleString('zh-CN')}</span>`;
        if (num < 0) return `<span class="sh-change down">▼ 减持 ${Math.abs(num).toLocaleString('zh-CN')}</span>`;
        return '<span class="sh-change neutral">— 不变</span>';
      }
      const s = String(c);
      if (s.includes('新进')) return '<span class="sh-change up">★ 新进</span>';
      if (s.includes('减')) return `<span class="sh-change down">▼ ${s}</span>`;
      if (s.includes('增')) return `<span class="sh-change up">▲ ${s}</span>`;
      return `<span class="sh-change neutral">— ${s}</span>`;
    };
    const typeTag = (t) => t === '机构'
      ? '<span class="sh-tag inst">机构</span>'
      : '<span class="sh-tag person">其他</span>';

    el.innerHTML = holders.map((h, i) => `
      <div class="sh-holder-row">
        <div class="sh-rank">${i + 1}</div>
        <div class="sh-holder-main">
          <div class="sh-holder-name">${this._esc(h.name)}${typeTag(h.type)}</div>
          <div class="sh-holder-bar"><div class="sh-holder-fill" style="width:${(h.holdRatio / maxRatio * 100).toFixed(1)}%"></div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="sh-holder-ratio">${h.holdRatio?.toFixed(2) || '0'}%</div>
        <div class="sh-holder-change">${changeLabel(h.change)}</div>
      </div>
    `).join('');
    this._setSource('shTopHolders', `数据来源：东方财富 F10 · 十大股东（${holders[0]?.endDate || '—'}）`);
  },

  _renderInstHoldTrend(trend) {
    const chart = this._init('shInstHoldTrend');
    const el = document.getElementById('shInstHoldTrend');
    if (!chart || !el) return;
    const dates = trend.map(t => t.date);
    const orgNums = trend.map(t => t.orgNum);
    const ratios = trend.map(t => t.freeRatio);
    const z = this._zoomFor(trend.length);
    const tooltipFmt = (params) => {
      const idx = (Array.isArray(params) ? params[0] : params)?.dataIndex ?? 0;
      const row = trend[idx];
      if (!row) return '';
      const change = (v) => {
        if (v == null) return '—';
        const s = v >= 0 ? `+${v}` : `${v}`;
        return v > 0 ? `<span class="sh-change up">${s}</span>` : v < 0 ? `<span class="sh-change down">${s}</span>` : `<span class="sh-change neutral">${s}</span>`;
      };
      return `<div style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:4px">${row.date}</div>
        <div>机构家数：${row.orgNum.toLocaleString('zh-CN')} 家（环比 ${change(row.orgNumChange)}）</div>
        <div>占流通股比：${row.freeRatio.toFixed(2)}%（环比 ${change(row.freeRatioChange)}）</div>`;
    };
    const zoom = [{ type: 'inside', start: z.start, end: z.end }, { type: 'slider', height: 18, bottom: 12, start: z.start, end: z.end }];
    let opt;
    if (window.SA3D && SA3D.bar25D) {
      const b = SA3D.bar25D({
        xData: dates,
        legend: { data: ['机构家数', '占流通股比%'], top: 0 },
        grid: { left: 55, right: 55, top: 40, bottom: 50 },
        xAxis: { type: 'category', data: dates, axisLabel: { rotate: 30 } },
        yAxis: [
          { type: 'value', name: '家数' },
          { type: 'value', name: '占比%', position: 'right' },
        ],
        axisPointer: { type: 'line' },
        tooltipFmt,
        series: [
          { name: '机构家数', type: 'bar', data: orgNums.map(v => ({ value: v, color: '#7fa8c9' })) },
          { name: '占流通股比%', type: 'line', yAxisIndex: 1, smooth: true, data: ratios, lineStyle: { width: 2 } },
        ],
      });
      b.dataZoom = zoom;
      opt = b;
    } else {
      opt = {
        tooltip: { trigger: 'axis', formatter: tooltipFmt },
        legend: { data: ['机构家数', '占流通股比%'], top: 0 },
        grid: { left: 55, right: 55, top: 40, bottom: 50 },
        xAxis: { type: 'category', data: dates, axisLabel: { rotate: 30 } },
        yAxis: [
          { type: 'value', name: '家数' },
          { type: 'value', name: '占比%', position: 'right' },
        ],
        dataZoom: zoom,
        series: [
          { name: '机构家数', type: 'bar', data: orgNums, itemStyle: { color: '#7fa8c9' }, barWidth: '50%' },
          { name: '占流通股比%', type: 'line', yAxisIndex: 1, smooth: true, data: ratios, lineStyle: { width: 2 } },
        ],
      };
    }
    chart.setOption(opt);

    // 汇总说明：最近两期机构家数变化与占流通股比变化
    const latest = trend[trend.length - 1];
    const prev = trend.length > 1 ? trend[trend.length - 2] : null;
    let noteEl = document.getElementById('shInstHoldNote');
    if (!noteEl) {
      noteEl = document.createElement('div');
      noteEl.id = 'shInstHoldNote';
      noteEl.className = 'sh-stats-note';
      el.parentNode.insertBefore(noteEl, el.nextSibling);
    }
    const changeText = (v, unit) => {
      if (v == null) return '—';
      const prefix = v > 0 ? '+' : '';
      return v > 0 ? `<span class="sh-change up">${prefix}${v}${unit}</span>` : v < 0 ? `<span class="sh-change down">${prefix}${v}${unit}</span>` : `<span class="sh-change neutral">不变</span>`;
    };
    const fmtShares = (v) => {
      const n = Number(v) || 0;
      if (n >= 1e8) return (n / 1e8).toFixed(2) + ' 亿';
      if (n >= 1e4) return (n / 1e4).toFixed(0) + ' 万';
      return n.toLocaleString('zh-CN');
    };
    const srcLine = `数据来源：东方财富 F10 · 机构持仓汇总（${latest.date}）· 共 ${trend.length} 个报告期`;
    const mainLine = `<div class="sh-stats-main">最新报告期 <b>${latest.date}</b>：机构家数 <b>${latest.orgNum.toLocaleString('zh-CN')}</b> 家，占流通股比 <b>${latest.freeRatio.toFixed(2)}%</b>，占总股本 <b>${(latest.totalRatio || 0).toFixed(2)}%</b>，合计持股 <b>${fmtShares(latest.totalShares)}</b> 股</div>`;
    if (prev && latest) {
      noteEl.innerHTML = `
        ${mainLine}
        <div class="sh-stats-sub">较上一期（${prev.date}）变化：机构家数 ${changeText(latest.orgNumChange, ' 家')}，占流通股比 ${changeText(latest.freeRatioChange, ' 个百分点')}。</div>
        <div class="sh-stats-sub">${srcLine}</div>
      `;
    } else {
      noteEl.innerHTML = `
        ${mainLine}
        <div class="sh-stats-sub">${srcLine}</div>
      `;
    }
  },

  _renderFundHoldings(holdings) {
    const el = document.getElementById('shFundHold');
    if (!el) return;
    const top = holdings.slice(0, 10);
    const maxRatio = Math.max(...top.map(h => h.ratio || 0), 0.0001);
    const fmtWan = (v) => {
      if (!v) return '—';
      const yi = v / 1e8;
      return yi >= 1 ? `${yi.toFixed(2)} 亿` : `${(v / 1e4).toFixed(0)} 万`;
    };

    el.innerHTML = top.map((h, i) => `
      <div class="sh-holder-row">
        <div class="sh-rank">${i + 1}</div>
        <div class="sh-holder-main">
          <div class="sh-holder-name">${this._esc(h.name)}<span class="sh-tag inst">基金</span></div>
          <div class="sh-holder-bar"><div class="sh-holder-fill" style="width:${(h.ratio / maxRatio * 100).toFixed(1)}%"></div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="sh-holder-ratio">${h.ratio?.toFixed(2) || '0'}%</div>
        <div class="sh-holder-change">${fmtWan(h.value)}</div>
      </div>
    `).join('');
    this._setSource('shFundHold', `数据来源：东方财富 F10 · 基金持股（${top[0]?.date || '—'}）· 按持股比例降序前 10`);
  },

  _esc(s) {
    if (!s) return '';
    return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, c => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;' }[c]));
  },
};

if (typeof window !== 'undefined') window.ShareholderCharts = ShareholderCharts;
if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) module.exports = ShareholderCharts;
~~~

~~~js
// stockLog.js — 个股行情判断记录（20261107 升级：原「个股记录」改为行情判断记录）
// 20261108a：新增「涨跌幅判断正确率」——系统按真实日K自动结算，对的显示 ✓、错的显示 ✗，
//            右上角展示当前准确率；两个下拉菜单非必填，未填方向不纳入准确率统计。
// 落盘 data/stock-log/<代码>.json。纯手动记录 + 模块内自统计，不参与任何判断/评分/回测。
// 列表按日期先后（正序）排列；支持关键词检索 + 方向/依据筛选 + 排序切换（先后/倒序）。
(function () {
  'use strict';

  // 与后端 lib/stockLog.js 同源的枚举显示名（A 股：红涨绿跌）
  const DIR_LABEL = { up: '上涨', sideways: '震荡', down: '下跌' };
  const BASIS_LABEL = { technical: '技术面', news: '消息面', other: '其他' };

  // 20261108a：勾 / 叉 / 待验证图标（inline SVG，形状本身即语义，颜色只作辅助）
  const ICON_OK = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3.2 8.4l3.1 3.1 6.5-6.6"/></svg>';
  const ICON_BAD = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4.4 4.4l7.2 7.2M11.6 4.4l-7.2 7.2"/></svg>';
  const ICON_PENDING = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="4.2" cy="8" r="1.05"/><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="1.05"/><circle cx="11.8" cy="8" r="1.05"/></svg>';

  const S = { symbol: null, name: null, loaded: null, items: [], accuracy: null };
  let editingId = null;
  const filters = { q: '', dir: '', basis: '' };
  let sortDir = 'asc'; // asc = 日期先后（正序）；desc = 倒序

  function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }
  function esc(s) {
    return String(s == null ? '' : s)
      .replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
      .replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
  }
  // 本地时区今天（toISOString 是 UTC，晚上 8 点后日期会错一天）
  function todayStr() {
    const d = new Date();
    return d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  }
  function signedPct(v) {
    if (v == null || !isFinite(Number(v))) return '缺失';
    const n = Number(v);
    return (n > 0 ? '+' : '') + n.toFixed(2) + '%';
  }

  // 方向徽标（A 股：上涨红 / 下跌绿 / 震荡灰；未填方向显示「未填」）
  function dirClass(d) {
    if (d === 'up') return 'sl-dir-up';
    if (d === 'down') return 'sl-dir-down';
    if (d === 'sideways') return 'sl-dir-sideways';
    return 'sl-dir-na';
  }
  function dirBadge(d) {
    return '<span class="sl-dir ' + dirClass(d) + '">' + esc(DIR_LABEL[d] || '未填') + '</span>';
  }
  function basisBadge(b) {
    if (!b) return '<span class="sl-basis sl-basis-na" title="未选择判断依据">未填依据</span>';
    return '<span class="sl-basis sl-basis-' + esc(b) + '">' + esc(BASIS_LABEL[b] || '其他') + '</span>';
  }

  // 20261108a：结算结果徽标。未填涨跌方向 → 不显示图标（不纳入统计）；
  // 待验证 → 灰色省略号；已判定 → ✓ / ✗，title 附实际涨跌幅与验证日便于核对。
  function verdictBadge(it) {
    if (!it || !it.direction) return '';
    const actual = (it.actualChgPct == null) ? '实际涨跌幅缺失'
      : `${it.actualDate || '验证日缺失'} 实际 ${signedPct(it.actualChgPct)}（${DIR_LABEL[it.actualDirection] || '—'}）`;
    if (it.verdict === 'correct') {
      return '<span class="sl-verdict sl-verdict-ok" title="' + esc('判断正确｜' + actual) + '">' + ICON_OK + '<span class="sl-verdict-txt">对</span></span>';
    }
    if (it.verdict === 'wrong') {
      return '<span class="sl-verdict sl-verdict-bad" title="' + esc('判断错误｜' + actual) + '">' + ICON_BAD + '<span class="sl-verdict-txt">错</span></span>';
    }
    return '<span class="sl-verdict sl-verdict-pending" title="' + esc('待验证：验证日行情尚未生成或日K取数失败，不计入准确率') + '">' + ICON_PENDING + '<span class="sl-verdict-txt">待验证</span></span>';
  }

  // 20261108b：单行胶囊标签只放「标签 + 数值 + 最短计数」；
  // 完整明细与口径收进 title，避免把标签撑成大方块、把标题行拉高。
  function renderAccuracy(acc) {
    const box = $('slAccuracy'), rateEl = $('slAccRate'), detailEl = $('slAccDetail');
    if (!box || !rateEl || !detailEl) return;
    const caliber = (acc && acc.caliber) || '按真实日K自动结算';
    if (!acc) {
      rateEl.textContent = '—';
      detailEl.textContent = '尚无记录';
      box.title = '涨跌幅判断准确率：' + caliber + '；未填方向不纳入统计。';
      box.className = 'sl-acc';
      return;
    }
    rateEl.textContent = acc.rateText || '—';
    detailEl.textContent = acc.judged ? `对 ${acc.correct} · 错 ${acc.wrong}` : '暂无判定';
    const tip = [
      caliber + '。',
      '分母只含「有涨跌方向 + 已判定」的记录。',
      `已判定 ${acc.judged} 条（对 ${acc.correct} / 错 ${acc.wrong}）`,
    ];
    if (acc.pending) tip.push(`待验证 ${acc.pending} 条（验证日行情未生成或日K不可得，不计入）`);
    if (acc.noDirection) tip.push(`未填涨跌方向 ${acc.noDirection} 条，不计入`);
    box.title = tip.join('\n');
    box.className = 'sl-acc' + (acc.judged ? ' sl-acc-has' : '');
  }

  // 检索（备注/日期/方向/依据，含「未填」）+ 方向筛选 + 依据筛选 + 排序
  function visibleItems() {
    let arr = S.items.slice();
    const q = (filters.q || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (q) {
      arr = arr.filter(it => {
        const hay = [it.note, it.date, DIR_LABEL[it.direction] || '未填', BASIS_LABEL[it.basis] || '未填依据']
          .map(x => String(x || '').toLowerCase()).join(' ');
        return hay.indexOf(q) !== -1;
      });
    }
    if (filters.dir) arr = arr.filter(it => it.direction === filters.dir);
    if (filters.basis) arr = arr.filter(it => it.basis === filters.basis);
    arr.sort((a, b) => {
      const c = (a.date || '').localeCompare(b.date || '') || (a.createdAt || '').localeCompare(b.createdAt || '');
      return sortDir === 'asc' ? c : -c;
    });
    return arr;
  }

  function render() {
    const box = $('stockLogContainer');
    renderAccuracy(S.accuracy);
    if (!box) return;
    const items = visibleItems();
    if (!items.length) {
      const hasFilter = filters.q || filters.dir || filters.basis;
      box.innerHTML = '<div class="sl-empty">' +
        (hasFilter ? '没有符合检索/筛选条件的记录' :
          '暂无记录——用上方表单添加该个股的行情判断，按日期先后排列') + '</div>';
      return;
    }
    box.innerHTML = items.map(it => {
      // 编辑态：该条替换为行内编辑表单（日期 + 方向 + 依据 + 备注 + 保存/取消）
      if (editingId === it.id) {
        const dirOpts = '<option value=""' + (!it.direction ? ' selected' : '') + '>未选方向</option>' +
          ['up', 'sideways', 'down'].map(d =>
            '<option value="' + d + '"' + (it.direction === d ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + DIR_LABEL[d] + '</option>').join('');
        const basisOpts = '<option value=""' + (!it.basis ? ' selected' : '') + '>未选依据</option>' +
          ['technical', 'news', 'other'].map(b =>
            '<option value="' + b + '"' + (it.basis === b ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + BASIS_LABEL[b] + '</option>').join('');
        return '<div class="sl-item sl-editing">' +
          '<div class="sl-edit-form">' +
            '<div class="sl-edit-row">' +
              '<input type="date" class="sl-edit-date" value="' + esc(it.date) + '">' +
              '<select class="sl-edit-dir">' + dirOpts + '</select>' +
              '<select class="sl-edit-basis">' + basisOpts + '</select>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<textarea class="sl-edit-note" rows="3">' + esc(it.note) + '</textarea>' +
            '<div class="sl-edit-actions">' +
              '<button class="sl-save" data-id="' + esc(it.id) + '">保存</button>' +
              '<button class="sl-cancel">取消</button>' +
            '</div>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>';
      }
      return '<div class="sl-item">' +
        '<div class="sl-main">' +
          '<div class="sl-tags">' + dirBadge(it.direction) + verdictBadge(it) + basisBadge(it.basis) +
            '<span class="sl-date">📅 ' + esc(it.date) + '</span></div>' +
          '<div class="sl-note">' + esc(it.note).replace(/\n/g, '<br>') + '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="sl-btns">' +
          '<button class="sl-edit" data-id="' + esc(it.id) + '" title="修改该条记录">修改</button>' +
          '<button class="sl-del" data-id="' + esc(it.id) + '" title="删除该条记录">删除</button>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';
    }).join('');
    // 进入编辑态后聚焦文本框并定位到末尾，方便直接续写
    if (editingId) {
      const ta = box.querySelector('.sl-edit-note');
      if (ta) { ta.focus(); try { ta.setSelectionRange(ta.value.length, ta.value.length); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ } }
    }
  }

  async function refresh(force) {
    if (!S.symbol) return;
    // 已加载过且未强制刷新：仅重新渲染（筛选/排序切换无需重拉）
    if (!force && S.loaded === S.symbol) { render(); return; }
    const box = $('stockLogContainer');
    if (!box) return;
    box.innerHTML = '<div class="sl-empty">加载中…</div>';
    try {
      const resp = await fetch('/api/stock-log/' + encodeURIComponent(S.symbol));
      const data = await resp.json();
      S.items = (data && data.items) || [];
      S.accuracy = (data && data.accuracy) || null;
      S.loaded = S.symbol;
      editingId = null;
      render();
    } catch (e) {
      box.innerHTML = '<div class="sl-empty">记录加载失败：' + esc(e && e.message) + '</div>';
    }
  }

  async function add() {
    if (!S.symbol) { alert('请先选择个股'); return; }
    const dateEl = $('slDate');
    const dirEl = $('slDir');
    const basisEl = $('slBasis');
    const noteEl = $('slNote');
    const date = (dateEl && dateEl.value) || todayStr();
    // 20261108a：两个下拉允许空值，空字符串直接透传，后端存 null
    const direction = dirEl ? dirEl.value : '';
    const basis = basisEl ? basisEl.value : '';
    const note = (noteEl && noteEl.value || '').trim();
    if (!note) { alert('请先填写备注内容'); return; }
    const btn = $('slAdd');
    if (btn) btn.disabled = true;
    try {
      const resp = await fetch('/api/stock-log/' + encodeURIComponent(S.symbol), {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ date, direction, basis, note }),
      });
      const data = await resp.json();
      if (!data || !data.success) { alert('添加失败：' + ((data && data.error) || '未知错误')); return; }
      if (noteEl) noteEl.value = '';
      await refresh(true);
    } catch (e) {
      alert('添加失败：' + (e && e.message));
    } finally {
      if (btn) btn.disabled = false;
    }
  }

  async function remove(id) {
    if (!S.symbol || !id) return;
    if (!window.confirm('删除这条记录？删除后不可恢复。')) return;
    try {
      await fetch('/api/stock-log/' + encodeURIComponent(S.symbol) + '/' + encodeURIComponent(id), { method: 'DELETE' });
      await refresh(true);
    } catch (e) {
      alert('删除失败：' + (e && e.message));
    }
  }

  function startEdit(id) { editingId = id; render(); }
  function cancelEdit() { editingId = null; render(); }

  async function saveEdit() {
    if (!S.symbol || !editingId) return;
    const box = $('stockLogContainer');
    const form = box && box.querySelector('.sl-item.sl-editing');
    if (!form) { editingId = null; render(); return; }
    const dateEl = form.querySelector('.sl-edit-date');
    const dirEl = form.querySelector('.sl-edit-dir');
    const basisEl = form.querySelector('.sl-edit-basis');
    const noteEl = form.querySelector('.sl-edit-note');
    const date = (dateEl && dateEl.value) || '';
    const direction = dirEl ? dirEl.value : '';
    const basis = basisEl ? basisEl.value : '';
    const note = ((noteEl && noteEl.value) || '').trim();
    if (!note) { alert('备注不能为空'); return; }
    const btn = form.querySelector('.sl-save');
    if (btn) btn.disabled = true;
    try {
      const resp = await fetch('/api/stock-log/' + encodeURIComponent(S.symbol) + '/' + encodeURIComponent(editingId), {
        method: 'PUT',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ date, direction, basis, note }),
      });
      const data = await resp.json();
      if (!data || !data.success) {
        alert('保存失败：' + ((data && data.error) || '未知错误'));
        if (btn) btn.disabled = false;
        return;
      }
      editingId = null;
      await refresh(true);
    } catch (e) {
      alert('保存失败：' + (e && e.message));
      if (btn) btn.disabled = false;
    }
  }

  // 检索/筛选：读取工具栏控件并实时过滤重渲染
  function applyFilters() {
    const qEl = $('slSearch');
    const dirEl = $('slFilterDir');
    const basisEl = $('slFilterBasis');
    filters.q = qEl ? qEl.value : '';
    filters.dir = dirEl ? dirEl.value : '';
    filters.basis = basisEl ? basisEl.value : '';
    // 不重拉数据，仅前端过滤（S.loaded 可能已加载）
    if (S.loaded === S.symbol) render();
    else refresh(true);
  }

  function toggleSort() {
    sortDir = sortDir === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
    const btn = $('slSortBtn');
    if (btn) btn.textContent = sortDir === 'asc' ? '日期↑（先后）' : '日期↓（倒序）';
    render();
  }

  window.StockLog = {
    // 切股挂钩（app.js analyze / switchTab 调用）：同股已加载则跳过，避免重复拉取
    setStock(symbol, name) {
      if (S.symbol === symbol && S.loaded === symbol) return;
      S.symbol = symbol; S.name = name; S.loaded = null;
      S.items = []; S.accuracy = null;
      editingId = null;
      // 切股时重置检索/筛选/排序
      filters.q = ''; filters.dir = ''; filters.basis = '';
      sortDir = 'asc';
      const qEl = $('slSearch'); if (qEl) qEl.value = '';
      const fDir = $('slFilterDir'); if (fDir) fDir.value = '';
      const fBasis = $('slFilterBasis'); if (fBasis) fBasis.value = '';
      const sortBtn = $('slSortBtn'); if (sortBtn) sortBtn.textContent = '日期↑（先后）';
      renderAccuracy(null);
      refresh();
    },
    init() {
      const dateEl = $('slDate');
      if (dateEl && !dateEl.value) dateEl.value = todayStr();
      const addBtn = $('slAdd');
      if (addBtn) addBtn.addEventListener('click', add);
      const noteEl = $('slNote');
      if (noteEl) noteEl.addEventListener('keydown', (ev) => {
        if ((ev.ctrlKey || ev.metaKey) && ev.key === 'Enter') add();
      });
      // 检索 / 方向筛选 / 依据筛选 / 排序切换
      const searchEl = $('slSearch');
      if (searchEl) searchEl.addEventListener('input', applyFilters);
      const fDir = $('slFilterDir');
      if (fDir) fDir.addEventListener('change', applyFilters);
      const fBasis = $('slFilterBasis');
      if (fBasis) fBasis.addEventListener('change', applyFilters);
      const sortBtn = $('slSortBtn');
      if (sortBtn) {
        sortBtn.textContent = '日期↑（先后）';
        sortBtn.addEventListener('click', toggleSort);
      }
      renderAccuracy(null);
      const box = $('stockLogContainer');
      if (box) {
        box.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
          const del = ev.target.closest('.sl-del');
          if (del) { remove(del.dataset.id); return; }
          const edit = ev.target.closest('.sl-edit');
          if (edit) { startEdit(edit.dataset.id); return; }
          if (ev.target.closest('.sl-cancel')) { cancelEdit(); return; }
          if (ev.target.closest('.sl-save')) { saveEdit(); return; }
        });
        // 编辑框是动态生成的：快捷键用容器级事件委托（Ctrl+Enter 保存 / Esc 取消）
        box.addEventListener('keydown', (ev) => {
          if (!editingId) return;
          if ((ev.ctrlKey || ev.metaKey) && ev.key === 'Enter') { ev.preventDefault(); saveEdit(); }
          else if (ev.key === 'Escape' && ev.target && ev.target.classList && ev.target.classList.contains('sl-edit-note')) {
            cancelEdit();
          }
        });
      }
    },
  };
})();
~~~

~~~js
/**
 * Storage Module - Manages watchlist and search history.
 * 自选股真源已迁移到服务端（/api/watchlist + data/watchlist.json），localStorage 仅作离线兜底。
 */
const Storage = {
  WATCHLIST_KEY: 'stock_analyzer_watchlist',
  HISTORY_KEY: 'stock_analyzer_history',

  // 服务端真源缓存；null = 尚未从服务端加载（回退 localStorage）
  _serverWatchlist: null,

  _wlUrl() { return '/api/watchlist'; },

  // 启动后从服务端拉取自选股真源；失败则保持 null（用 localStorage 兜底）
  async initWatchlist() {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(this._wlUrl(), { cache: 'no-store' });
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        let list = Array.isArray(data.list) ? data.list : [];
        if (list.length === 0) {
          // 服务端为空：可能是「升级到服务端持久化」后的首次运行。
          // 若本地 localStorage 仍有旧数据，则回填服务端（迁移），避免清空用户已有的自选股。
          try {
            const local = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(this.WATCHLIST_KEY) || '[]');
            if (Array.isArray(local) && local.length > 0) {
              await this._pushWatchlist(local); // 写回服务端并设 _serverWatchlist=local
              return local;
            }
          } catch {}
        }
        this._serverWatchlist = list;
        // 同步缓存到 localStorage（离线兜底）
        try { localStorage.setItem(this.WATCHLIST_KEY, JSON.stringify(list)); } catch {}
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // 服务端不可达：_serverWatchlist 保持 null，回退 localStorage
    }
    return this.getWatchlist();
  },

  // 将最新列表写回：始终更新本地缓存（离线兜底），服务端可达则同步写回
  async _pushWatchlist(list) {
    try { localStorage.setItem(this.WATCHLIST_KEY, JSON.stringify(list)); } catch {}
    try {
      await fetch(this._wlUrl(), {
        method: 'PUT',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ list }),
      });
      this._serverWatchlist = list;
    } catch (e) {
      // 写回失败不影响本地；下次 initWatchlist 会重新从服务端拉取
    }
  },

  // ---- Watchlist ----
  getWatchlist() {
    if (this._serverWatchlist) return this._serverWatchlist;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(this.WATCHLIST_KEY) || '[]');
    } catch { return []; }
  },

  addToWatchlist(stock) {
    const list = this.getWatchlist().slice();
    if (!list.find(s => s.symbol === stock.symbol)) {
      list.push({ symbol: stock.symbol, name: stock.name, market: stock.market, addedAt: Date.now() });
      this._pushWatchlist(list);
    }
    return list;
  },

  removeFromWatchlist(symbol) {
    const list = this.getWatchlist().filter(s => s.symbol !== symbol);
    this._pushWatchlist(list);
    return list;
  },

  // 持久化任意顺序（拖拽排序）
  setWatchlist(list) {
    this._pushWatchlist(list.slice());
    return list;
  },

  // 置顶：把该股票移到列表最前
  pinToTop(symbol) {
    const list = this.getWatchlist().slice();
    const i = list.findIndex(s => s.symbol === symbol);
    if (i > 0) {
      const [item] = list.splice(i, 1);
      list.unshift(item);
      this._pushWatchlist(list);
    }
    return list;
  },

  // 移动到分组（group 为空字符串表示「未分组」）
  moveToGroup(symbol, group) {
    const list = this.getWatchlist().slice();
    const item = list.find(s => s.symbol === symbol);
    if (item) {
      if (group && group !== '') item.group = group;
      else delete item.group;
      this._pushWatchlist(list);
    }
    return list;
  },

  // 所有已存在的分组名（去重、排除空）
  getGroups() {
    const groups = new Set();
    this.getWatchlist().forEach(s => { if (s.group) groups.add(s.group); });
    return Array.from(groups);
  },

  isInWatchlist(symbol) {
    return this.getWatchlist().some(s => s.symbol === symbol);
  },

  // ---- History ----
  getHistory() {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(this.HISTORY_KEY) || '[]');
    } catch { return []; }
  },

  addToHistory(stock) {
    let list = this.getHistory();
    list = list.filter(s => s.symbol !== stock.symbol);
    list.unshift({ symbol: stock.symbol, name: stock.name, market: stock.market, time: Date.now() });
    list = list.slice(0, 20);
    localStorage.setItem(this.HISTORY_KEY, JSON.stringify(list));
    return list;
  },

  clearHistory() {
    localStorage.removeItem(this.HISTORY_KEY);
  },

  // ---- Format helpers ----
  formatTime(ts) {
    const diff = Date.now() - ts;
    const min = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
    const hour = Math.floor(diff / 3600000);
    const day = Math.floor(diff / 86400000);
    if (min < 1) return '刚刚';
    if (min < 60) return min + '分钟前';
    if (hour < 24) return hour + '小时前';
    if (day < 7) return day + '天前';
    return new Date(ts).toLocaleDateString('zh-CN');
  },

  formatNumber(n, decimals = 2) {
    if (n === null || n === undefined || isNaN(n)) return '--';
    if (Math.abs(n) >= 1e8) return (n / 1e8).toFixed(decimals) + '亿';
    if (Math.abs(n) >= 1e4) return (n / 1e4).toFixed(decimals) + '万';
    return n.toFixed(decimals);
  },

  formatPercent(n, decimals = 2) {
    if (n === null || n === undefined || isNaN(n)) return '--';
    return (n > 0 ? '+' : '') + n.toFixed(decimals) + '%';
  }
};
~~~

~~~html
  <title>投资心得 / 大盘记录 · 股票分析工作台</title>
  <link rel="icon" type="image/x-icon" href="favicon.ico?v=20261025f">
  <link rel="icon" type="image/png" sizes="512x512" href="icon.png?v=20261025f">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/style.css?v=20261106p">
  <!-- 独立长页：恢复滚动。html,body 须同时覆盖（html 无法由共享样式按页选择），
       故保留这一条页内规则；其余样式统一在 style.css「独立长页统一外壳」段（20261025f）。 -->
  <style>
    html, body { height: auto !important; overflow-y: auto !important; overflow-x: hidden; }
    /* 20261102f：「量能涨跌关系分析」入口复用 .np-tab 芯片外观（<a> 需去下划线） */
    a.np-tab { text-decoration: none; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="np-page">
    <header class="jd-header">
      <h1 class="jd-title" id="npTitle">🧠 投资心得</h1>
      <div class="jd-actions">
        <button id="npAddBtn" class="btn-primary" type="button">写心得</button>
        <a href="index.html" class="btn-text">返回工作台</a>
      </div>
    </header>

    <!-- 范围切换工具条：sticky 统一工具条 + 统一芯片（tab 动作纯文字，DESIGN.md §6）
         20261102f：「大盘记录」tab 替换为「量能涨跌关系分析」入口（用户指令）——新窗口打开
         思维导图页 volume-map.html；大盘记录笔记仍可从工作台顶部导航进入（index.html 顶部按钮） -->
    <div class="np-toolbar">
      <button class="np-tab" type="button" data-scope="global">投资心得</button>
      <a class="np-tab np-tab-link" href="volume-map.html?v=20261102k" target="_blank" rel="noopener" title="在新标签页打开量能涨跌关系分析思维导图">量能涨跌关系分析</a>
      <span class="np-count" id="npCount"></span>
    </div>

    <!-- 记录列表：Notes.renderScopePage() 渲染（与首页卡片同一套 .note-card 结构） -->
    <main class="np-list" id="scopePageList"></main>
  </div>

  <script src="js/notes.js?v=20261106p"></script>
  <script>
  (function () {
    // 按 ?scope= 决定本页范围（global=投资心得 / market=大盘记录），写入 body[data-page-scope]
    var q = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('scope');
    var scope = (q === 'market') ? 'market' : 'global';
    document.body.dataset.pageScope = scope;

    var meta = Notes.SCOPE_META[scope];
    document.title = meta.title + ' · 股票分析工作台';
    document.getElementById('npTitle').textContent = meta.title;

    var addBtn = document.getElementById('npAddBtn');
    addBtn.textContent = meta.addLabel;
    addBtn.onclick = function () { Notes.showForm(scope); };

    // 范围切换 tab：跳转同页带新 scope（服务端渲染无需 SPA 状态管理）
    // 20261102f：仅绑定 data-scope 的 tab（「量能涨跌关系分析」入口是 <a> 链接，不走 scope 跳转）
    var tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.np-tab[data-scope]');
    for (var i = 0; i < tabs.length; i++) {
      tabs[i].classList.toggle('active', tabs[i].getAttribute('data-scope') === scope);
      tabs[i].onclick = function () {
        if (this.getAttribute('data-scope') === scope) return;
        location.href = 'notes.html?scope=' + this.getAttribute('data-scope');
      };
    }

    // 计数徽标：挂在 renderHome 之后（本地同步渲染与服务端 reconciliation 完成后都会走这里）
    var countEl = document.getElementById('npCount');
    var origRenderHome = Notes.renderHome.bind(Notes);
    Notes.renderHome = function () {
      origRenderHome();
      countEl.textContent = '共 ' + Notes.getByScope(scope).length + ' 条';
    };

    Notes.init();
  })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
~~~
